name: ANSI/IEEE ammeter symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for ammeter, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The ammeter form identifies current indication from a direct or instrument-transformer measurement. Current input and auxiliary power connections serve different functions, so a compact instrument circle is read with its terminal diagram.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace the current circuit and CT reference together.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: An ammeter is a measuring instrument rather than an overcurrent protective function number.
